description: This script is used to automate end-to-end testing of the OpenClaw onboarding process within a Docker environment. It builds Docker images, runs onboarding flows with various configurations, validates generated configs, and manages environment setup and logs.
external_files: docker build context (Dockerfile, associated image files)

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends payload data after a delay in the child process.

methods.name: wait_for_log
methods.description: Waits for a specific log message within a timeout period, inspecting log files or output streams.

methods.name: start_gateway
methods.description: Starts a local gateway node process.

methods.name: wait_for_gateway
methods.description: Polls until the gateway is listening and connected.

methods.name: stop_gateway
methods.description: Stops the running gateway process.

methods.name: run_wizard_cmd
methods.description: Runs an onboarding wizard command with input/output handling and validation.

methods.name: run_wizard
methods.description: Performs a standard onboarding sequence.

methods.name: make_home
methods.description: Creates a temporary home directory for test runs.

methods.name: set_isolated_openclaw_env
methods.description: Sets environment variables for isolated OpenClaw environment.

methods.name: assert_file
methods.description: Checks for existence of a file and exits if not found.

methods.name: assert_dir
methods.description: Checks for existence of a directory and exits if not found.

methods.name: select_skip_hooks
methods.description: Automates wizard step to skip hooks.

methods.name: send_local_basic
methods.description: Simulates user input to proceed in onboarding wizard without additional steps.

methods.name: send_reset_config_only
methods.description: Automates reset configuration flow in wizard.

methods.name: send_channels_flow
methods.description: Configures channels during onboarding via wizard.

methods.name: send_skills_flow
methods.description: Configures skills during onboarding via wizard.

methods.name: run_case_local_basic
methods.description: Runs a test case for local onboarding with verification of generated config files.

methods.name: run_case_remote_non_interactive
methods.description: Runs a test case for remote onboarding with verification.

methods.name: run_case_reset
methods.description: Runs a reset config onboarding flow and verifies the resultant config.

methods.name: run_case_channels
methods.description: Runs the wizard for channel configuration and validates the resulting config.

methods.name: run_case_skills
methods.description: Runs wizard for skills configuration and validates the resulting config.

methods.name: assert_log_not_contains
methods.description: Ensures a specific string does not exist in the log output.

methods.name: validate_local_basic_log
methods.description: Checks logs for specific unwanted output during local onboarding.
